_comment: Two n8n MCP surfaces. (1) n8n-mcp: external tool (npx), node docs/search/validation — 7 core tools need no creds; its 13 mgmt tools would need a PUBLIC-API key in N8N_API_KEY (aud=public-api). (2) n8n-builtin: n8n's OWN MCP server at /mcp-server/http, authenticated with an MCP-SERVER key (aud=mcp-server-api) via Bearer; the token is read from ${N8N_MCP_SERVER_TOKEN} (set in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json — never commit it here, public repo). Requires n8n running + MCP access enabled (Settings → MCP).
